sentences.en: The procession will make its start at the central square.
sentences.zh: 游行将在中央广场开始。

sentences.en: The mayor walked at the head of the procession.
sentences.zh: 市长走在游行队伍的最前面。

sentences.en: The procession always passes through the town's oldest streets.
sentences.zh: 游行总是经过镇上最古老的街道。

senses.zh: 队伍，行列；一列，一排；列队行进

mnemonic: 词根记忆：process（队列行进）+ion（表名词）→向前走的→队伍
